title: Card Review Window for Home Delivery Pharmacy Down Payments
content:
## Billing desk guidance: which card payments are reviewed

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment-plan down payment, the card review window depends on how long the account has been open on the handling date: for an account open 60 whole months or more it covers card payments dated less than 24 whole months before the handling date, for an account open less than 12 whole months it covers card payments dated less than 6 whole months before, and for every other account it covers card payments dated less than 12 whole months before.

Months open are whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date; card payments are member payments made by credit card, debit card or HSA/FSA card.

### Window table

| Whole months open on the handling date | Card payments reviewed are those dated less than |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 24 whole months before |
| 12 through 59 | 12 whole months before |
| fewer than 12 | 6 whole months before |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical accounts)

- 60 whole months open: 24-month window; 59: 12-month window.
- 12 whole months open: 12-month window; 11: 6-month window.
- A card payment dated exactly 12 whole months before the handling date is outside a 12-month window.
